item: IG Biomedizinische Forschung und Innovation (IG Biomed)
detail: Member of an interest group, promoted by the pharmaceutical lobby Interpharma, defending biomedical research and innovation. Reported in his parliamentary register of interests.
Member of the committee of the Gen Suisse foundation, which promotes research on genetic engineering in medicine and agriculture.
Sat on numerous committees of agricultural federations, reflecting his role as a representative of farming interests; mandates ended on his election to the Federal Council.
